events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, known as Liam Gallagher, was born on September 21, 1972, and rose to fame as the iconic frontman of Oasis.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam track, solo or with Oasis?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (UK Single)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem "Imagine" was released as a single in the UK on October 1, 1975, promoting his 'Shaved Fish' compilation album.

angles.name: Imagine 51 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a UK single. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Unveiled
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket" and changing portable music forever.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket was mind-blowing? Apple introduced the first iPod 25 years ago this month, kicking off a revolution in how we listen. What was your first portable music player?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day, observed annually on October 5th, celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable villains, 007 has been thrilling us for decades. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, would have been 86 today, born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, famous for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Silly Walks & Basil Fawlty
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: A masterpiece of its time, The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58 this month. Its diverse tracks showcased the band's evolving artistry. What's your standout track from this legendary double album?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away on November 24, 1991, aged 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the extraordinary Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting remain unparalleled. Join us in celebrating the life and legacy of a true rock icon.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, "Rubber Soul", in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track from this pivotal record?

events.title: John Lennon Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this sombre anniversary, we remember John Lennon, whose life was tragically cut short 46 years ago. His music and enduring message of peace continue to resonate globally.
